clair: Heads-up - integrating the JS SDK into an Expo (managed) app on Hermes. Metro picks the ESM entry and we get runtime errors: global.crypto missing, ReadableStream undefined. Anyone have a minimal repro or fix?

jon: Yup, seen it. Metro follows the exports/import field. If SDK's import points to dist/index.mjs Metro will try to bundle ESM and that drags in node libs. Do you control metro config?

clair: I can change metro for the app but we want a path with minimal app changes. Typescript also complains since types reference node:stream.

ravi: Short term: pin to the CJS file via a direct import (require('sdk/dist/index.cjs')) or use a resolver alias. Also add polyfills: react-native-get-random-values, web-streams-polyfill, and an AbortController shim.

jon: Metro alias example: ```js
// metro.config.js
const path = require('path')
module.exports = { resolver: { extraNodeModules: { 'my-sdk$': path.resolve(__dirname, 'node_modules/my-sdk/dist/index.cjs') } } }
```

clair: That worked. But TypeScript still pulls in Node types because d.ts references ReadableStream/Node streams. We used skipLibCheck for now.

ravi: For a cleaner fix, request the SDK to ship a react-native entry in package.json or a separate tsc types file that avoids node libs. Also ask for a lightweight browser/UMD build without Node-only deps.

clair: I'm drafting a GH issue. What exact repro steps should I include?

jon: Minimal repro: expo init (blank) -> expo prebuild -> enable Hermes in android/app.json -> npm i my-sdk react-native-get-random-values web-streams-polyfill abortcontroller-polyfill -> add shims at top of App.js: `import 'react-native-get-random-values'; import 'abortcontroller-polyfill/dist/abortcontroller-polyfill-only'; import 'web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill';` -> import SDK normally and run on Android emulator. Attach Metro logs showing it picked dist/index.mjs.

ravi: Also include a small tsconfig demonstrating the type error and the stack trace from tsc.

expo-bot: Note: Expo SDK 48+ exposes crypto.getRandomValues in managed workflow. Dev clients and older SDKs may still need polyfills. See https://blog.expo.dev/

clair: Thanks all. I'll open the issue with the metro log/snippets and request: 1) publish react-native or main -> cjs, 2) separate type definitions without Node libs, 3) RN compatibility docs. I'll paste the repo link when ready. :thumbsup:
